_comment: Lightweight scan sources for scripts/scan_sources.py. Only plain-HTML, non-JS, non-bot-walled pages belong here — the scanner does a simple regex link scrape, not a full browser render. Sources that 403/redirect-loop against a generic User-Agent (e.g. Synthonia, SonicWire's search, korg.shop) were tried and dropped; prefer the weekly agent prompt in AUTOMATION.md for those.
